Geographies Served Programs Facilities District Pune State Maharashtra District Pune States Maharashtra Vidyarthi Sahayyak Samiti has prioritised providing affordable lodging and boarding in Pune for economically disadvantaged rural students since 1955. Beyond basic accommodation, it emphasizes personality development, operating on principles of cleanliness, equality, and dignity of labour. Each room accommodates 3 to 4 students with essential amenities. Meals are provided twice daily in the hostel mess, fostering community engagement. Hostels feature libraries to encourage reading and computer labs for academic support and skill-building courses. Additionally, health services are available on-site, with sports facilities promoting physical activity and character development through teamwork and resilience. Activities District Pune State Maharashtra District Pune States Maharashtra The organisation's focus extends beyond offering lodging and boarding; it aims to nurture students' personalities through a range of programmes. These include group discussions, English language classes and presentations, mandatory yoga and sports sessions, cultural events, cooking lessons, debates, elocution exercises, storytelling, lectures by experts from diverse fields, educational excursions, and entrepreneurship development initiatives. Its goal is to shape rural students into confident and cultured individuals. Milestones & Track Record Starting with arranging meals for 5 students in 1955, Samiti now operates 4 hostels housing over 700 students and has helped transform the lives of thousands of rural students over the past 65+ years. --> --> Leadership Team Chandrakant Kulkarni Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Pratap Pawar Chairman Tushar Ranjankar Managing Trustee Durgesh Pawar Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Makarand Phadke Trustee M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAATS4498N Registration Number E-219 CSR Form 1 Not Available VO ID / Darpan ID MH/2017/0176412 --> 80G AAATS4498NF20217 12A AAATS4498NE20214 FCRA 083930059 About Headquarters Pune, Maharashtra Since 1955 Demographies Served Youth Children Girls Adolescents --> Impact Thousands of rural students have benefited from Samiti's assistance, with many able to complete higher education who otherwise may not have had the opportunity.
